notes: The Examiner publishes the same articles through two registered feeds — sf-examiner and sf-examiner-social — and the social feed's item title is a teaser sentence rather than the headline. Where a story reached both, it is read and cited here, under the headline the article itself carries.

coverage.note: Six items queued, all six read. One named a San Francisco building. The events round-up names three venues — 2665 Mission St, 1 Jones St and 201 Van Ness Ave — as the places three ticketed events happen at; a venue hosting an event is the textbook passing mention news/AGENTS.md excludes, so none is a finding.

findings.description: The Presidio Trust has signed a lease turning this three-storey, 40,000-square-foot building of 1896, built as U.S. Army barracks, into a members-only flexible office space, due to open in the spring.

citation.label: San Francisco Examiner, “Former Army barracks in Presidio becoming flexible office space,” 19 August 2026

raw.text: Built in 1896, the 40,000-square-foot building at 102 Montgomery St. once served as U.S. Army barracks.

resolution.method: EAS exact match on 102 MONTGOMERY ST → parcel 1300001; sf-parcels has blklot 1300001 active, 428–434 AMATURY; the 2025 roll records it as miscellaneous/mixed-use. The assessor files the parcel as 3550 WEST PACIFIC AV. EAS puts 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106 MONTGOMERY ST on that parcel, so per the directory contract the fact belongs on one page at the lowest, 101.
resolution.note: No page at this path yet; the parcel is the publisher's to seed.
